newsitem.title: USA: North American Technologies seeks buys.
newsitem.headline: North American Technologies seeks buys.

text.p: North American Technologies Group Inc. said it hired investment banker GulfStar Group Inc to help it seek acquisitions.
The company has not yet identified any of the acquisitions, it said.

The acqusitions would ideally have yearly revenue of between $15 and $25 million and be related to the company's core manufacturing or marketing businesses, North American Technologies said. The company said it would pay for the acquisitions with cash, debt, issuance of common stock and independent financing.
